key_findings: Single index patient (85-year-old man, AML with monocytic differentiation, intramarrow Ara-C, died in hospice); discussion used only where literal about this patient.
Draft placed unlabelled result sentences in dated biopsy/count events and its summary gave 2.5% blasts the 18-week time; both corrected.
Condition + procedure + observation for Doppler/echo/CT diagnoses follows corpus precedent (diagnostic procedure plus findings, diagnosis as condition); no identical duplicate items found.
Pleural regression (after 2 weeks) and pericardial complete regression (untimed CT) are kept separate; no time borrowed for the pericardial CT.
EVID-NEGATION warnings on f042 ("nontender"), f105 ("symptom-free", U+2010 hyphen), f138 ("untreated") and GLUED-TEXT on "promonocyte" are checker false positives.
residual_risks: Relation e12->e16 relies on the introduction sentence describing the patient with AML treated with intramarrow Ara-C (treating a named existing condition).
Visual.json Graph 1/2 descriptions say the markers sit over the 6 and 18 tick positions, a reading of x positions from chart points; change requested from the annotator.
